coverage_limits: Only the supplied excerpts, template, and legacy facts were used; no external search, other conversation, or unprovided judgment text was used.

The focal stage is a Delhi High Court Article 227 petition challenging the Rent Control Tribunal's eviction order. Tribunal conclusions are preserved as PRIOR_FOUND and contested at the focal stage rather than treated as uncontested truth.
A SUPPORT link means only that the cited fact tends to support the literal test proposition; it does not itself establish the statutory eviction ground.
The supplied material contains no independently inspected original evidence; statements about documents on record are treated only as court-described record facts.

The 1944 claim in F6 and the prior-court temporal findings in F10-F11 are unresolved within the supplied material. That conflict is confined to time-dependent uses and is not propagated into unrelated tests.

For DRC_SUBLETTING_C02, the excerpts that use 'let out' or 'sub-let' do not separately set out all supplied incidents of subletting: transfer of an interest in the estate, payment of rent, and right to possession.

Knowledge, notice, or authority is not equated with written consent. F4 is the only supplied legacy fact that directly records a finding of no consent in writing; F5 and F8 remain UNKNOWN on that test.
The 'licensees' characterization in F9 does not by itself establish retained legal possession or absence of whole ouster, so it provides only qualified support for DRC_SUBLETTING_C06.
F7's respondent-number references are not mapped to E1-E9 because the supplied legacy fact provides no entity_ids for F7; no identity is manufactured from role numbering.
No supplied case fact supports an assignment route under DRC_SUBLETTING_C03, and no fact sufficiently establishes the positive parting-with-possession test DRC_SUBLETTING_C04.

No COMPATIBLE complete-object combination is proposed because the supplied temporal materials are not explicitly bound to the same disposition transaction as the otherwise better-specified Canara Bank-Petitioner subletting and written-consent findings.
